🔹 **Room thanda aur hawa daar rakhein:** Garmi rash ko aur badha sakti hai.  
🔹 **Hydration:** Bachche ko regular paani ya ORS pilayein agar wo pee raha ho.

⚠️ **TURANT HOSPITAL/DOCTOR KE PAAS JAYEIN AGAR:**
- Saans lene mein takleef, khansi, ya awaaz bhari ho
- Chehra, hont, jeebh, ya gala sujh raha ho
- Ultiyon, behoshi, ya bachcha usual se zyada thaka hua/sleepy ho
- Rash ke saath bukhar (100.4°F/38°C se upar) ho
- Rash tezi se phail raha ho ya dardnak ho jaye

Aajkal **teleconsultation, home-visit pediatricians, ya emergency helplines** bhi available hain agar jaane mein dikkat ho. Bachche ki skin aur immune system bahut sensitive hota hai, isliye koi bhi dawai (antihistamine, steroid cream, etc.) doctor ki salah ke bina bilkul na dein.

Bachche ki suraksha sabse upar hai. Kripya kisi qualified pediatrician se turant sampark karein. Agar aapko teleconsultation ke options chahiye toh main usme bhi madad kar sakta hoon.
